function.arguments: {"finding": "The email campaign was deliberately targeted at existing high-value customers, as stated in the data dictionary. This means that the customer_segment distribution differs between channels — email is likely to have a higher share of 'loyal' and 'returning' customers, who naturally have higher conversion rates. Therefore, a raw comparison of conversion rates between channels is confounded by customer_segment. The observed difference may not reflect the true effect of the campaign.", "implication": "We cannot report the raw difference in conversion rates (email minus paid_search) as the causal effect of the campaign. We must adjust for customer_segment, either by stratifying, standardising, or modelling. Otherwise, we risk attributing differences due to targeting to the channel itself."}
function.name: note_finding
